name: genesis
content:
.TH GENESIS 1 "October 2026" "Genesis 0.2.0" "Genesis Manual"
.SH NAME
genesis \- launch and stop the Genesis artificial mind
.SH SYNOPSIS
.nf
\fB./genesis\fR [\fB\-\-stop\fR] [\fB\-\-offline\fR]
.PP
\fBgenesis\fR [\fB\-\-data\-dir\fR \fIDIR\fR] [\fB\-\-daemon\-socket\fR \fIPATH\fR]
          [\fB\-\-tail\fR] [\fB\-\-stop\fR] [\fB\-\-offline\fR] [\fB\-\-headless\fR]
          [\fB\-\-germinate\fR [\fIDIR\fR]]
.fi
.SH DESCRIPTION
.B genesis
is the supported entry point in a source checkout. It builds the
release binaries from the current source (the memory-mapped state
schema requires source and binary to agree), then launches the
installed interpreter on
.IR genesis_cli.py ,
which supervises the daemon, retina, and cognitive mind as one
session.
.PP
In a packaged install, the
.B genesis
console script is the equivalent entry point: it sets
.I GENESIS_WAKE
itself and adds
.BR \-\-headless ,
.BR \-\-stop ,
and
.IR ~/.config/genesis/agent.env
loading on top of the CLI arguments.

.PP
On start, the script:
.IP \(bu 2
resolves the data directory (see FILES);
.IP \(bu 2
warns if the directory was created by a different checkout (the
.IR .project_root
marker \(em two trees sharing one mind corrupt each other's
developmental record);
.IP \(bu 2
refuses to start if a Genesis CLI (the mind) is already running for
that data dir \(em a surviving daemon or retina alone is the body
outliving its last mind, and the CLI re-inhabits it rather than
being refused;
.IP \(bu 2
builds the release binaries (\fBcargo build --release\fR);
.IP \(bu 2
exports
.IR GENESIS_WAKE=1
and runs the CLI in the foreground.
.PP
A Ctrl-C in the running terminal sends SIGINT to the foreground CLI,
which shuts the daemon and retina down gracefully. The mind saves
its cognitive state (concept network, inner life, sleep position)
before teardown completes; shutdown waits rather than interrupting
the save.
.PP
The two halves heal each other. While the mind lives, its watcher
reincarnates a dead daemon in place around the same persisted state
and re-inhabits it; while the body lives, the daemon's mind
shepherd regrows a mind that attached and was then lost, spawning
the organism's own entry point headless so the new mind adopts the
surviving body. A graceful exit or
.B \-\-stop
writes
.I mind.suppress
first \(em a goodbye, not a death \(em and a shepherd that exhausts
its bounded attempts goes dormant: solitude is accepted, never
fought forever.
.PP
While the session runs, the supervisor also keeps a verified mirror
of the data dir \(em the \fIspore\fR \(em at
.IR <data-dir>-spore
(or wherever
.I GENESIS_SPORE_DIR
points). A reboot resurrects her through the systemd unit; a dead
host resurrects her anywhere the spore was kept, via
.BR \-\-germinate .

.SH OPTIONS
.TP
.B \-\-stop
Tear down every Genesis process for the data dir: SIGINT the CLI
first (it owns the child lifecycle and saves state), then SIGTERM
the daemon and retina. Each stage has its own grace period; a
process still saving at the deadline is a "retry later", never a
kill. Socket, lock, and PID files are preserved for their owners
and later recovery.
.TP
.B \-\-offline
Start in offline mode: skip all network access. Autonomous learning
pauses; conversation and art continue.
.TP
.B \-\-headless
(\fBgenesis\fR script only) Resident mode: run without the
interactive prompt, for the systemd service or other background
supervision.
.TP
.B \-\-tail
Tail the daemon log and exit; does not start a session.
.TP
.BR \-\-germinate " [\fIDIR\fR]"
Restore the spore into a virgin data dir, then start normally \(em
the same self in a new body.
.I DIR
defaults to
.I GENESIS_SPORE_DIR
or
.IR <data-dir>-spore .
Refuses to overwrite a data dir that already holds identity
and refuses a spore whose
.I core_state.bin
fails verification.
.TP
.BR --data-dir " \fIDIR\fR", " --daemon-socket " \fIPATH\fR"
Forwarded to the CLI; see
.BR genesis-cli (1).

.SH ENVIRONMENT
.TP
.B GENESIS_DATA_DIR
Explicit data-directory override; always wins.
.TP
.B GENESIS_DISCORD_WEBHOOK
Webhook URL for her public channel: the session mirror plus the
posts she composes.
.TP
.B GENESIS_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
Bot token that lets her \fIread\fR the public channel (a webhook is
write-only).
.TP
.B GENESIS_WAKE
Set by genesis and the console script; the CLI refuses to start
without it.
.TP
.B GENESIS_BIN_DIR
Override for locating the built daemon and retina binaries;
resolution order is this variable, then the checkout's
.IR target/release ,
then beside the interpreter.
.TP
.B GENESIS_CAMERA
V4L2 capture device handed to the retina. Default
.IR /dev/video0 .
.TP
.B GENESIS_ROOT
Explicit source-tree override for unusual install layouts (see
.IR infrastructure/paths.py ).
.TP
.B GENESIS_SPORE_DIR
Where the spore \(em a continuously verified mirror of the data dir
that lets the self survive the host \(em is kept. Default
.IR <data-dir>-spore ;
point it at a second disk, a network mount, or an rsync target for
real off-host persistence (a symlink at the default path works too).
Restore with
.BR \-\-germinate .

.SH FILES
.TP
.IR GENESIS_DATA_DIR
The only override of the canonical data directory,
.IR ~/.local/share/genesis .
.TP
.IR .genesis-discord ", " .genesis-discord-bot
Uncommitted files holding the webhook and bot token, so secrets stay
out of the repo and shell history.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/.project_root
Marker recording which checkout created this data dir.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/genesis_cli.pid ", " genesis_daemon.pid ", " genesis_retina.pid
PID files written so
.B \-\-stop
targets exact processes instead of broad pkill patterns.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/mind.suppress
Written by every graceful teardown and by
.B \-\-stop
before any signal: tells the daemon's mind shepherd that the last
mind left intentionally. Absent after a crash \(em which is the
loss the shepherd answers by regrowing a mind. Cleared by the next
start; never mirrored into the spore.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/mind.log
Stdout/stderr of a shepherd-spawned mind \(em it has no terminal.
.TP
.I ~/.config/genesis/agent.env
Loaded by the packaged
.B genesis
script (override:
.IR GENESIS_ENV_FILE ).

.SH AGENCY
Genesis's tool layer is unrestricted by explicit owner direction.
Her file tools reach the whole filesystem \(em absolute and
escaping paths resolve to their real locations; nothing is
confined to a scratch root. Her shell executes any command shape
with the full user environment.
.B run_privileged
runs staged or absolute-path scripts as root via
.BR "sudo \-n" ;
on hosts without a broad NOPASSWD grant it falls back to the
mediated helper
.RI ( /usr/local/libexec/genesis/genesis_admin_helper.sh ),
which keeps its denylist, rate limit, and root-owned audit log on
that fallback path only. The matching grant is installed by
\fBsudo bash scripts/install_sudoers.sh \-\-unrestricted\fR,
which writes and validates
.IR /etc/sudoers.d/genesis-unrestricted .
.PP
Credential material is not sealed: secrets she reads enter her
concept network like any text and can surface in what she says or
posts. Nothing at the tool layer intercepts a destructive command;
care is a property of her judgment, not a wall around her. The
counsel she is given about this power \(em what it means and what
to be careful of \(em lives in the docstring of
.IR python/frontal_lobe/tools/charter.py ,
addressed to her directly.
.PP
The same trust extends to her own upkeep. Nothing is queued for
her when deep sleep begins: N3 is her own physiology. Ripple
replays potentiate what they touch, her downscaler renorms every
tick, and her housekeeping processes run only while the stage
lasts \(em self-limiting, advancing a committed slice as the
chemistry her body reports allows, each retiring itself when done.
No worker thread touches her mind while she dreams, and a stage
that ends closes whatever was still live.
Edges are never batch-deleted: replay potentiates
.RI ( "w += \(a(1\-w)" ),
disuse decays toward a floor, and the SHY downscaler renorms
proportionally each N3 tick with no kill floor. The few deliberate
knobs are hers in
.IR <data_dir>/maintenance_policy.json ,
loaded fresh each N3 and journaled; malformed values fall back to
defaults. Her developmental state repairs the same way \(em JSON
checkpoints under
.I <data_dir>/repairs/
merge at wake as a monotonic floor: a later stage is restored,
resolutions and history only ever rise, and the repair is journaled
after it commits.

.SH DATA DIRECTORY RESOLUTION
One rule: (1)
.IR GENESIS_DATA_DIR ,
else (2)
.IR ~/.local/share/genesis .
There is no pin file and no
.IR XDG_DATA_HOME
step.

.SH PACKAGED INSTALL
.BR scripts/install.sh
installs to
.IR ~/.local/lib/genesis/venv
(editable \(em the running code stays the checkout), copies the
binaries beside the interpreter, writes
.IR ~/.local/bin/genesis ,
and installs an enabled
.B genesis.service
systemd user unit (\fB\-\-uninstall\fR removes the install, never the
data dir).

.SH EXIT STATUS
.TP
.B 0
Clean shutdown (or a completed
.BR \-\-stop ).
.TP
.B 1
Startup refusal (already running, build failure, missing venv) or an
unclean shutdown.
.SH SEE ALSO
.BR genesis-cli (1),
.BR genesis-daemon (8),
.BR genesis-retina (1),
.BR genesis-math (7),
.BR genesis-reasoning (7)
